Jordan L: Ivy wants Private POC fast (48h). Main asks: BYOK with KMS/HSM, cert exchange, ephemeral cert handling. Any immediate blockers?

Amy S: They insist on customer-managed keys. Two paths: full BYOK (AWS KMS or HSM-wrapped) or we offer Redwood-managed key for faster onboarding.

Dmitri K: For BYOK we need KMS key ARN with a policy granting our service principal, or a wrapped key blob from their HSM. Also request a CA-signed agent cert. No infra code change on our side.

Rebecca M: Security items: HSM attestation doc if they provide HSM, CSR->CA-signed cert, rotation cadence (POC can accept 30d), and escrow plan. Prod requires 7d rotation.

Jordan L: Can we give them copy-paste commands and minimal JSON to send back?

Dmitri K: Yes. CSR example:
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out agent.key
openssl req -new -key agent.key -out agent.csr -subj "/CN=redwood-agent.ivy.poc/O=Ivy"

Dmitri K: Minimal JSON we need:
{ "customer":"Ivy", "vpc_id":"vpc-0abc", "kms_key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/...", "agent_cert_pem":"-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----...", "agent_key_wrapped":"base64..." }

Amy S: If they choose Redwood-managed keys we need a short custody addendum signed; that path can be <24h. I'll prepare the opt-in form.

Rebecca M: I'll draft the security blurb for their questionnaire and loop in legal for the addendum.

infra_bot: Onboard checklist created: https://internal.redwood/onboard/1979234567

Jordan L: Great. Amy, Rebecca, Dmitri - please post the checklist + script + copy-paste commands and I'll confirm the 48h window with Ivy.

Amy S: Will do in ~30m.
